name: Albuñol (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow tower and a white isosceles triangle at the hoist bearing three blue wavy stripes.
history: Albuñol adopted its arms and flag officially on 17 December 2007; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of a red cloth with a yellow tower masoned black and open in red, with a white isosceles triangle at the hoist bearing three wavy stripes.

features.role: tower masoned black and open in red
isosceles triangle with its base along the hoist
three wavy stripes on the triangle
